an8.10:1.1: 10 ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā campāyaṃ viharati gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
an8.10:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū bhikkhuṃ āpattiyā codenti
an8.10:1.3: so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi āpattiyā codiyamāno aññenāññaṃ paṭicarati bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti kopañca dosañca appaccayañca pātukaroti.
an8.10:2.6: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
an8.10:2.8: yato ca khvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti
an8.10:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave sampanne yavakaraṇe yavadūsī jāyetha yavapalāpo yavakaraṇḍavo
an8.10:3.2: tassa tādisaṃ yeva mūlaṃ hoti seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ
an8.10:3.3: tādisaṃ yeva nālaṃ hoti seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ
an8.10:3.4: tādisaṃ yeva palāsaṃ hoti seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ yavānaṃ
an8.10:3.6: yato ca khvassa sīsaṃ nibbattati tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti
an8.10:3.8: tamenaṃ iti viditvā samūlaṃ uppāṭetvā bahiddhā yavakaraṇassa chaḍḍenti
an8.10:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
an8.10:4.3: yato ca khvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti
an8.10:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave mahato dhaññarāsissa phusayamānassa tattha yāni tāni dhaññāni daḷhāni sāravantāni tāni ekamantaṃ puñjaṃ hoti yāni pana tāni dhaññāni dubbalāni palāpāni tāni vāto ekamantaṃ apavahati
an8.10:5.2: tamenaṃ sāmikā sammajjaniṃ gahetvā bhiyyoso mattāya apasammajjanti
an8.10:5.5: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
an8.10:5.7: yato ca khvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti
an8.10:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso udapānanāḷiyatthiko tiṇhaṃ kudhāriṃ ādāya vanaṃ paviseyya
an8.10:6.2: so tantadeva rukkhaṃ kudhāripāsena ākoṭeti tattha yāni tāni rukkhāni daḷhāni sāravantāni tāni kudhāripāsena ākoṭitāni kakkhaḷaṃ paṭinadanti
an8.10:6.3: yāni pana tāni rukkhāni antopūtīni avassutāni kasambujātāni tāni kudhāripāsena ākoṭitāni daddaraṃ paṭinadanti
an8.10:6.4: tamenaṃ mūle chindati mūle chinditvā agge chindati agge chinditvā anto suvisodhitaṃ visodheti anto suvisodhitaṃ visodhetvā udapānanāḷiṃ yojeti
an8.10:6.5: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃyeva hoti abhikkantaṃ paṭikkantaṃ ālokitaṃ vilokitaṃ sammiñjitaṃ pasāritaṃ saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇaṃ seyyathāpi aññesaṃ bhaddakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
an8.10:6.7: yato ca khvassa bhikkhū āpattiṃ passanti tamenaṃ evaṃ jānanti
